On Fomo/Pump Apps Onboarding Retail via Memecoin Trading
Is this really a sustainable path for crypto adoption?
> “it's basically gambling/sports betting but much worse for the average user”
Source:
https://x.com/lesabrefomo/status/2087926915604865524

tweet.text:
I know this is an unpopular take, but I truly dont think the direction we are heading with the fomo/pump apps onboarding retail via memecoin traders is a very productive or sustainable path. At least in its current form

it's basically gambling/sports betting but much worse for the average user. 

Even if we onboard a ton of new users via memecoin trading, do we really think many of these people survive longer than a few months? Onchain is a minefield with sharks ready to attack any weakness

Ive seen this cycle happen firsthand with many of my non crypto friends who dabbled with memes last cycle on moonshot. It was fun for a few weeks, lost all of their money and now are afraid to touch it again

It is a very, very attractive "game" from the outside looking in. Those PnLs look crazy and people love to chase that. I get that. The issue is the trading style required for these PnLs is not the style getting pushed across tiktok/ig where these people are getting onboarded

Ethereum Foundation Abandons Poseidon, Pivots to SHA and BLAKE
> After eight years, the Ethereum Foundation is abandoning the SNARK-friendly hash for SHA and BLAKE.
> Breakthrough binary-field SNARK designs proved that traditional hash functions can match Poseidon's performance, unlocking post-quantum security without exotic cryptographic assumptions.
Source:
https://x.com/drakefjustin/status/2087905684180418733

tweet.text:
Goodbye, Poseidon!

An epic 8-year, 8-figure rabbit hole in post-quantum cryptography reaches its dream conclusion. The Ethereum Foundation is abandoning Poseidon for L1, pivoting to SHA or BLAKE. This milestone unlocks ultimate security for lean Ethereum and foreshadows a golden era of hash-based cryptography.

Since 2018, the Ethereum Foundation has invested in magic cryptographic bricks, so-called "SNARK-friendly hashes". In 2019, Poseidon was born. It held strong and became the dominant SNARK-friendly hash, securing billions via zkrollups and zkVMs.

In a stunning reversal, breakthrough SNARK designs show that SNARK-friendly hashes aren't necessary after all. Off-the-shelf traditional hash functions like SHA2 and BLAKE2s can now match Poseidon in a SNARK. In hindsight the key was not SNARK-friendly hashes, but hash-friendly SNARKs.

We have some difficult news to share. Unfortunately, one of our shipping providers has experienced a data breach that exposed sensitive order data. This affects new customers in the US, UK, Sweden, Colombia, Brazil, Italy, and Portugal who received an order within the 90 days prior to August 8th, 2026.

The data exposed:

- Full names
- Shipping addresses
- Phone numbers
- Email addresses 

The incident affects 11,742 customers with full exposure (name, email, phone number, shipping address) and 1,947 customers with partial exposure (name, city, email). The breach is limited due to Trezor’s strict 90-day data storage policy (we were also able to negotiate the same terms with fulfillment partners, who follow the same policy).

All affected customers have been contacted separately by email.

Our systems and devices remain secure, but affected customers could experience an increase in phishing attempts.

Link
Fidelity proposes adding staking to its ≈$898M spot Ethereum ETF (FETH). It would retain 85% of gross staking rewards for the fund and distribute the remaining 15% to service providers, with net rewards passed to investors via quarterly cash distributions.
Matters because: This may support better ETH ETF economics and could incentivize further institutional ETH accumulation if approved, though timing remains uncertain.

On Edge and Max Extracting
> Edge is often temporal. it is important that you identify if yours is, and if so, proceed to max extract.
> You need to make large, concentrated bets when you identify an unusually large, high conviction edge.
> Equally, it is important you identify when your edge has decayed.
> Assuming you still have an edge after it has decayed, and acting like you still do, is one of the most counterproductive things you can do.
Source:
https://polarthedegen.substack.com/p/on-edge-and-max-extracting

The Expanding Business Model of Blockchains
> Blockchains can no longer survive on selling blockspace alone.
> Things are changing, and chains are now actively pushing to become more than chains.
> They are doing this either by expanding their ecosystem offerings or by adding value to their own ecosystem by building applications themselves
